reviews.text: My parents had them build a pergola a few years ago. When one of the boards started rotting out they wouldn’t even respond to my mom about coming out and giving her a quote to fix it.
reviews.author: James Horton

reviews.text: We had a full perimeter 8 foot fence with an electric sliding gate installed and couldn't be more pleased with the result. High-quality product from a very responsive and personable local company. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Guy Briggs

reviews.text: We hired Creative Boundries to rebuild our outdoor kitchen. Our bar and countertop had been poorly designed and were not easy to use. Derek took time to talk through what we wanted and made some great suggestions to resolve our issues. The work was done with great craftsmanship and quality. We also asked them to build rock boarders around some flowerbeds. We have been very pleased with the results.
reviews.author: Walter Beesley

reviews.text: We had Creative Boundaries add a large covered back porch, outdoor kitchen, and new 8' fence in our back yard.  We couldn't be more pleased with the work!  The covered porch looks like it was originally part of the house and the kitchen / fence work was of top notch quality.  Any time we had an issue or concern, they immediately corrected to make sure it was exactly the way we wanted it.  They definitely take pride in their work!  Would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Jason Hess

reviews.text: I received a quote from Derek and Creative Boundaries to run a simple drain pipe from the backyard to the sidewalk to help drainage and rainwater runoff in Feb 2021. After receiving quotes from other companies, I decided to go with Creative Boundaries. I e-mailed Derek giving him the green light to proceed with work a week or two after the initial quote, but never received a response back. It was only after 2 more e-mails a week apart that he responded (a month later) that he had forgotten about me and would try to set something up. Another month later, another e-mail reminder, and again, no response. I have given up on hoping Derek and Creative Boundaries will ever follow through on their quote and have moved on to another company.
reviews.author: R

reviews.text: Extremely happy with the patio/outdoor kitchen remodel. Derek & his team did an amazing job! They transformed our backyard into a true outdoor living space. They were very responsive and professional. Very happy with their work.
reviews.author: Michelle L

reviews.text: Had a beautiful, upscale outdoor kitchen built with a 30x15 patio addition and full sidewalk from front to back of house with luxurious stone borders, pillars included, around my bushes and trees. The job was so professionally done and the artistic vision that the group has really showed in the final product. Ten stars from me.
reviews.author: Derek Brandow

The stone trim work is beautiful and the seamless match to our existing roof line and shingles makes it appear as if it was part of the original structure --> - Bob & Shirley Garrity, Castle Hills Texas - Outdoor Living Construction, Pool & Patio Your home is a reflection of you, an expression of your creativity. It all starts with the moment you arrive home, that first impression. At Creative Boundaries , we specialize in making your Outdoor Living project a special part of your home. Creative Boundaries is a full-service outdoor contractor offering design consultation through specialty exterior construction. We have helped homeowners in Coppell, Flower Mound, Grapevine, Southlake, Frisco – and other Dallas suburbs – realize their dream home. From custom patio structures and pergolas , to spectacular stonework and decorative concrete , opulent outdoor kitchens and living spaces. Most importantly, we work closely with each homeowner to truly understand their expectations and vision for the project. Then we work hard to exceed it. To us, each outdoor living project, no matter how big or small, is an opportunity to create something unique. Creative Boundaries looks at angles and lighting and textures as they relate to the individual characteristics of each home and yard. We incorporate personal preferences to meet the individual needs of the homeowner. We maximize budgets and utilize the highest possible quality products. As a result, Creative Boundaries delivers a value that is beyond compare. Creative Boundaries was built around the idea that every project is treated as though it were our project, our home, our yard. This philosophy is the driving force behind all of our designs and decisions. At Creative Boundaries, you’ll find experienced professionals who are able to strike the perfect balance of form and function. As a result, we create exceptional exteriors that enhance your lifestyle while also enhancing the value of your home. Find out why Creative Boundaries is the DFW choice for exterior remodeling, pool remodeling , and construction in North Texas. FAQs Do You Offer Free Estimates? Yes! We will set up a time to come out and meet with you in person. We will discuss the requirements of your project and take pictures and measurements. This will allow us to create an accurate proposal for your project. Our estimates are always no-pressure and no-obligation, so you will never feel you’re being forced into a situation you’re uncomfortable with. If you’re interested in an estimate, contact us today. Do I need a Permit for my outdoor living project? Not all outdoor living projects need permits. When a permit is required, Creative Boundaries will submit all the documentation and obtain the permit from your city officials. We will also insure compliance with all city codes for each project. Do You Use High-Pressure Sales Tactics? We don't believe in "sales" at all really. The fact is, our potential customers call or contact us because they have an idea of what they would like. As a company, our job is to understand what the customer wants and make sure we can deliver the best most cost effective solution. No one likes to be "sold" anything, so we will just present our proposal based on your input, and hope you like it well enough to hire us for your outdoor living project. Why Should I Choose Creative Boundaries? We are a full-service outdoor contractor and offer design consultation through specialty exterior construction. Creative Boundaries brings over 35 years of experience to every project ensuring a perfect balance of beauty and durability. We are proud to be a locally owned and operated company right out of Coppell Texas. A vast majority of our workforce and materials are sourced from this area. We don't expect you to just give us your business, we would very much like the opportunity to earn it. data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The company receives high praise for quality craftsmanship and design on complex outdoor projects. A clear, specific complaint pattern exists regarding unresponsiveness after project completion or for small repairs, which lowers the score slightly. The low total review count is a minor concern, but the content is credible.

authentic_signals: Specific project details (perimeter fence, outdoor kitchen rebuild, covered porch)
Mix of glowing praise and specific, credible complaints
